sprite_sequence.text: No, no, no -- not on the very first day!
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels panicked and flustered, with a burst of frustrated disbelief at being late on the very first day and a strong urge to fix it immediately.
sprite_sequence.label: embarrassed

sprite_sequence.text: Why did the train have to stall today of all days?!
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She’s flustered and frustrated, feeling panicked that bad luck is ruining her chance to start the term properly.
sprite_sequence.label: anxious

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She’s abruptly startled and confused, her urgency momentarily giving way to wary curiosity as she tries to make sense of the strange sight ahead.
sprite_sequence.label: surprised

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She shifts from frantic self-focused panic to immediate, open concern, sounding gently worried and ready to help the crying child despite being in a rush.
sprite_sequence.label: anxious

sprite_sequence.text: Whoa, seriously? Don't move, okay? I'm here.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She shifts instantly from frantic impatience to protective concern, feeling urgent and sympathetic as she tries to steady the crying boy and take charge of the situation.
sprite_sequence.label: anxious

sprite_sequence.text: ...Ah, man. Fine. First day and I'm already doomed.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels frustrated and resigned about being late, but her concern for the crying boy is overriding her own panic, leaving her flustered yet determined to help.
sprite_sequence.label: determined

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She’s pushing past her frustration and lateness to focus on the crying boy, sounding brisk and caring as she tries to take charge and calm him down.
sprite_sequence.label: determined

sprite_sequence.text: Okay, Kota. I'm Aoi. We're going to find your mom together.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels a quick shift from frustrated panic to determined, reassuring protectiveness, choosing to take charge and help the boy despite being late.
sprite_sequence.label: determined

sprite_sequence.text: Did you come from the station? The bakery? Somewhere with lots of people?
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She is focused and brisk, masking her own stress with practical urgency while trying to sound reassuring and in control for the boy's sake.
sprite_sequence.label: determined

sprite_sequence.text: Got it. Flower shop. Come on, hold my sleeve tight.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels briskly determined and protective, pushing aside her own panic about being late so she can keep the frightened boy close and get him safely to his mother.
sprite_sequence.label: determined

sprite_sequence.text: Excuse me! Did anyone see a woman looking for a little kid in a yellow cap?
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She is focused and urgent, pushing past her own frustration and lateness with determined concern as she takes charge to help the lost boy.
sprite_sequence.label: determined

sprite_sequence.text: It's okay. He stayed near the crossing. He was really trying to be brave.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels relieved and quietly moved, with a warm protective pride in the boy and a lingering rush from having helped reunite him with his mother.
sprite_sequence.label: smile

sprite_sequence.text: Next time, don't chase buses, okay? They're not that interesting.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She’s relieved and quietly proud after helping them reunite, and she covers her lingering concern with a light, teasing joke to keep the mood cheerful.
sprite_sequence.label: smile

sprite_sequence.text: Oh, wow. I am absolutely dead.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels a mix of comic despair and resigned panic about being late, but underneath it there’s a warm afterglow of relief and pride from helping the lost boy.
sprite_sequence.label: anxious

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels breathless, a little resigned about being late, but warmly satisfied and quietly proud that helping Kota was the right choice.
sprite_sequence.label: smile
